ppjeg1bq.baseName: Charles Bentley 4ft Indoor Pre-Lit 420 Warm White LED Christmas Tree - Gold
ppjeg1bq.variantName: Charles Bentley 4ft Indoor Pre-Lit 420 Warm White LED Christmas Tree - Gold
ppjeg1bq.sourceDescription: Our 4ft Pre-Lit Gold Twig Tree is the centrepiece you've been looking for. With 420 constant LED warm white lights illuminating its slender gold branches, this tree glows with a rich, luxurious warmth that transforms any room, whether it's nestled in a hallway, bedroom, or living room. The gold finish catches the light beautifully, adding shimmer and depth to the branches and creating a look that's simultaneously bold and refined. Unlike a traditional Christmas tree, the open twig silhouette gives the lights room to breathe, allowing the glow to radiate. At 4ft tall, it works equally well as a standalone statement piece or alongside other decorations. The 420 pre-fitted LEDs mean it's ready to glow from the moment you plug it in – no additional lighting required. Ideal for: Hallways and other floor areas, bedrooms, home offices, and glamorous or maximalist Christmas interiors. Please Note: For indoor use only. Keep away from heat sources and open flame. CE certified. Features: • Rich gold finish with 420 constant warm white LEDs – warm luminous and glamorous • Open twig silhouette allows light to radiate outward filling the room with a soft golden glow • 420 pre-fitted constant warm white LED lights – no additional lighting required • Pre-lit for a completely fuss-free setup • Plug-in power source – CE certified for UK and EU use • Constant light function – steady uninterrupted warm glow • No timer included – lights controlled via plug Includes: • 1x Pre-Lit Gold Twig Tree • Pre-fitted plug-in cable Materials: • Plastic (branches) Dimensions: H122, W55, D55cm Warning: indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and combustible materials. Place on a stable surface and keep the cable where it cannot be pulled or tripped over. Unplug before assembly, adjustment or cleaning. Do not use if the plug, cable, wiring or lights are damaged. Keep away from young children and pets. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

k61h55cy.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Reusable - White - 150 cm
k61h55cy.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Reusable - White - 150 cm
k61h55cy.sourceDescription: This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree redefines seasonal décor with its realistic appearance and innovative design, transforming any living space into a festive haven. Its modern style and lifelike leaf arrangement make it a captivating centerpiece for homes during the holiday season while maintaining a sleek, minimal aesthetic. Crafted with simplicity and functionality in mind, this tree is easily assembled, blending seamlessly into various décor styles and imbuing environments with the warmth and joy synonymous with Christmas. Materials: Crafted from high-grade PVC and steel, offering durability and a realistic look. The materials ensure the tree withstands multiple seasons while retaining its visual appeal. This blend not only adds to the longevity but also enhances the visual aesthetics of the tree, making it look lush and full. Included Components: Equipped with decorative string lights that seamlessly adorn the tree, providing a warm white glow that enhances its natural look. Coupled with a reliable metal stand that ensures the tree stays upright and stable throughout the festive season. Features /Function /Design: The hinged construction allows for quick setup and disassembly, saving both time and effort. The lifelike tips give it a fresh, full appearance, while the foldable stand provides convenience for storage and stability in use. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms, this tree can complement a variety of home decors, enhancing the holiday spirit. It transforms spaces with its decorative lights and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions for optimal stability. Ensure the LED lights are handled with care to maintain their function and longevity. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 104 cm Stand size: 35 cm Hinged construction for set up, Lifelike Tips, Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 519 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 1500 cm Number of LEDs: 150 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Cable length: 200 cm Indoor use only Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

vk6yjfrm.baseName: My Christmas Heavy Duty Real Christmas Tree Stand with 3.7L Water Reservoir
vk6yjfrm.variantName: My Christmas Heavy Duty Real Christmas Tree Stand with 3.7L Water Reservoir
vk6yjfrm.sourceDescription: Keep your real Christmas tree upright and hydrated throughout the festive season with this sturdy Christmas tree stand. Designed to support trees up to 8ft tall, it features a wide, stable base and four adjustable metal screw clamps to grip the trunk securely and help prevent wobbling or leaning. The integrated 3.7L water reservoir provides convenient water storage to help maintain your tree's freshness and reduce premature needle drop. Made from durable polypropylene (PP), the lightweight, rust-proof stand is easy to clean and can be reused year after year. Key Features: • Suitable for real Christmas trees up to 8ft tall • Four adjustable metal screw clamps help secure the tree trunk and keep it upright • Built-in 3.7L water reservoir helps keep real trees hydrated • Wide, stable base provides reliable support • Durable polypropylene construction is lightweight and rust-proof • Suitable for compatible artificial trees with an appropriate trunk • Easy to clean and store after the festive season • Reusable design for seasonal use year after year Specifications: • Material: Polypropylene (PP) • Water reservoir capacity: 3.7L • Maximum tree height: 8ft • Maximum trunk diameter: 14cm • Clamps: 4 adjustable metal screw clamps Dimensions: • Diameter: 48cm • H19cm Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
